design: 5-fold refit on each set's train clips (splits/split_<set>.json folds): per outer fold k, fit on the other 4 folds, alpha re-chosen by fold-mean R2 over those 4 folds (per position for perpos; by clip for pooled / halves), score fold k; the stored test clips are not used. Probes, standardisation and metrics as the probe stage (per-position R2 = mean over sin, cos columns)
onset_rule: first SAMPLED point with the fold's metric >= 90% of its max over the sampled points
